Subject: Next steps: Private deployment architecture deep‑dive & scheduling

Hi Erika / Tom —

Thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

- Recap: CloudMed is evaluating a private VPC deployment for PHI workloads with an initial scope of 3 services (ingest, inference, audit logging). You flagged network isolation, data residency, and KMS integration as must-haves.
- Goal for next meeting: a technical deep-dive with our SEs to walk through architecture options (VPC peering vs. PrivateLink, on‑prem connector, KMS/HSM patterns) and confirm requirements for the pilot.

Proposed times (all PDT):
- Thu Jul 23, 10:00–11:00 AM
- Thu Jul 23, 2:00–3:00 PM
- Fri Jul 24, 9:00–10:00 AM

Can you confirm which slot works and who from CloudMed should join (network, security, infra owner)? If none of those work, share a couple windows that do.

Prep from our side: Sergio and Stephanie will lead the technical walk; Laura will join for timeline/contract questions. If you have a rough network topology or the architecture-outline PDF you mentioned, please drop it in reply — saves time during the session. I've attached a short one‑page outline of topics we plan to cover.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachment: cloudmed-arch-outline.pdf

Priyom — quick note from the SE side. I can take the architecture walkthrough. A couple asks so we can make the hour productive: 

1) Audience & roles: please confirm whether CloudMed will include a networking engineer (VPC/subnet CIDR owner), security lead (KMS/HSM), and the SRE who will operate the pilot.
2) Current infra: if they can share a very high-level diagram (even hand-drawn) showing how traffic enters their environment and where PHI is stored, that helps us tailor the alternatives.
3) Constraints: any egress rules, private DNS needs, or air-gap requirements?

Availability: I can do Thu Jul 23 10:00 or Fri Jul 24 9:00. Stephanie can cover fallback on Thu 2:00 if needed.

Also attaching the SOC2 summary we reference often — helps reassure security folks.

—Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.com

Priyom / Sergio —

Thanks for the clear summary. Thu 23 Jul 10:00–11:00 AM PDT works for us. Joining: Tom Keller (infrastructure lead), Maya Singh (networking), and I will bring our security manager (name TBD).

I've attached a one-page sketch of our infra and a short list of constraints — mostly CIDR ranges we need to keep and the requirement that KMS keys be customer-managed. I'm dropping the files to the Drive link below as well.

One ask on our side: please include a short runbook example for failover/rollback during the pilot so our ops team can evaluate the operational model.

See you at 10:00 — please send a calendar invite and the dial-in/Zoom link.

Thanks,
Erika Moss
Director of Product Operations, CloudMed Inc.
erika.moss@cloudmed.com | +1 (650) 777-0210
